prerequisites: No prerequisites for students from Mechanical Engineering or Management Engineering degrees. Students not enrolled in these programs can take 'Fondamenti e Metodi della Progettazione Industriale' provided they have prior knowledge of Mechanical Drawing. They can take 'Marketing e Sviluppo Prodotto' provided they have prior knowledge of Business Management.

learning_outcomes.text: Providing methodological knowledge as to planning new product development after a market-driven perspective, by also stimulating creativity and entrepreneurship culture in the students. The course is multidisciplinary, in order to stimulate students to approach to the same problem after different perspectives.

The student will be able to plan, design, implement and manage the development of new products and processes. The contextual design after a market and a technical perspective will make the student approach real business contexts.
Students in groups have to design a new product by their own, thus developing their capability of making autonomous decisions.

Technical language on the contents of the course will be developed. Furthermore, time management will be developed since students are asked to present their projects in 3 minutes to an external experts jury of entrepreneurs and managers.
The student will acquire knowledge for approaching to the work in competitive contexts where new product development is an issue. Team working is also developed.

syllabus_topics: LEAN CANVAS AND BUSINESS MODEL CANVAS
LABORATORY (24 HOURS) - application of theoretical knowledge to develop a new product satisfying an unsatisfied market need (group work)

assessment_methods.method: Drafting of a marketing plan (for Marketing e Sviluppo Prodotto course)

assessment_rules: For both courses, the exam includes an individual written test, the drafting of a group paper, and its presentation. For 'Marketing e Sviluppo Prodotto', a marketing plan is also required. Grades are determined based on analytical quality, strategic coherence, operational feasibility, correct use of marketing tools, critical and creative ability, and clarity of presentation for the marketing plan; for the written exam, understanding theoretical concepts and applying them to real-world contexts; for the project plan, problem analysis, consistent methodologies, efficient solutions, and effective market placement. The overall grade for 'Marketing e Sviluppo Prodotto' is the average of the Marketing Plan grade, the Written Exam grade, and the Project grade. The overall grade for 'Fondamenti e Metodi della Progettazione' is the average of the Written Exam grade and the Project grade.
